title: Catch Log — Species, Size, and Spot
dataSources: Fishing catches (`fishing:catch`), fishfinder sonar (`fishfinder:reading`), foraging finds (`foraging:find`), game-cam triggers (`gamecam:trigger`).
app: Outdoor logs — fishing apps (Fishbrain), sonar / fishfinder exports, game/trail cameras, and foraging journals — streamed to Splunk HEC via APIs and scripted inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=fishing:catch
| stats count as catches, max(length_cm) as biggest, values(spot) as spots by species
| sort - catches
description: Logs every catch by species, size, and location, building the fishing diary that reveals your best patterns.
value: A structured catch log turns fishing luck into learnable patterns of species, spot, and personal-best size.
implementation: Ingest catches into `index=personal`; summarise by species with biggest and spots.
visualization: Table of catches by species with biggest fish and spots.
grandmaExplanation: It logs every fish you catch with its size and where, building a diary of your best spots.
